name: Apollo
summary: Sales intelligence and engagement platform with a large B2B contact database. Find ideal-fit leads, enrich them and run multichannel outreach from one place.
best_for: sales teams that want prospecting data, enrichment and sequencing in one affordable all-in-one platform
skip_if: you need guaranteed-accurate data at volume — budget for credit overages, or pair it with a verification step
honest_knock: The credit and export caps are the catch — real usage on enrichment and dialing often runs well above the sticker, and data accuracy is hit-or-miss, so verify before you outreach at scale.

plans.name: Basic
plans.includes: $65 month to month; 30,000 credits per seat per year, granted upfront

plans.name: Professional
plans.includes: $99 month to month; 48,000 credits; the tier most teams land on

plans.name: Organization
plans.includes: $149 month to month, three-seat minimum; 72,000 credits. Credit limits mean the effective cost often runs higher than the seat price

pricing.plans_source: hand-curated from the vendor's pricing page
pricing.notes: A free plan (900 credits per seat per year, 2 sequences); paid Basic $49, Professional $79 and Organization $119 per seat/mo billed annually, or $65, $99 and $149 month to month - the annual saving the page advertises is 24%. Organization carries a three-seat minimum, so it starts at $357/mo. Credit-based limits mean the effective cost often runs higher (re-verified 2026-10-01).

Which data can a customer export, in which formats, on which plans?
